business_model.claim: Strawberry Fields REIT generates substantially all of its revenues by leasing skilled nursing and other post-acute healthcare properties to healthcare operators under long-term triple-net leases, collecting monthly rent while tenants pay property taxes, insurance, facility operating costs, and capital expenditures.
quotes: We generate substantially all of our revenues by leasing our properties to tenants under long-term leases primarily on a triple-net basis, under which the tenant pays the cost of real estate taxes, insurance and other operating costs of the facility and capital expenditures.
We are entitled to monthly rent paid by the tenants and we do not receive any income or bear any expenses from the operation of such facilities.

quotes: Currently, our portfolio consists of 134 healthcare properties with an aggregate of 15,655 licensed beds.

business_model.claim: The company conducts and manages its business as one operating segment through an UPREIT structure in which it serves as general partner of Strawberry Fields Realty, L.P. and owned approximately 25.7% of outstanding OP units as of the 10-Q report date.
